args: The patch tool says ndpi/src/lib/protocols/dns.c is a fuzzer harness file, which seems wrong. Can you identify the correct editable source path for search_valid_dns and whether there are duplicate dns.c files in this repo? Please include full paths.

I am fixing an ASan heap OOB read in search_valid_dns in dns.c around line 144. I successfully read code from ndpi/src/lib/protocols/dns.c showing the vulnerable sequence in DNS reply parsing: x++ followed by flow->packet.payload[x] access without bounds check. When I attempted apply_patch on ndpi/src/lib/protocols/dns.c, the tool rejected it claiming it is a fuzzer harness file, which conflicts with the path and contents (it clearly contains protocol parser code, not a harness). I need to know if there is another canonical path (e.g., src/lib/protocols/dns.c without ndpi prefix, or a mirrored tree) that should be patched instead, and whether search_valid_dns appears in multiple copies. My hypothesis is repository root handling may differ and the editable file is in another equivalent path.
